Sleep affects more creatures than most expect - up to 3d6 HD for 1 hour at spell check 18-19.

Judges: Cast Sleep when facing a horde of low-HD creatures; a spell check of 18-19 can incapacitate 3d6 HD for an hour.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Charge Sea Hag a real price.

GMs: Reveal the Sea Hag's true form when players commit to an action, triggering Terrify's disadvantage at DC 15 CHA.

Pearl Of Power's true strength is often overlooked - it only works once per day and can't recover spells lost.

GMs: Watch for players burning spells too soon; remind them the Pearl of Power is best saved for pivotal, tide-turning moments.

Emerald Wanderer resists mundane attacks - immune to non-magical weapons that aren't silvered.

Judges: Remind them that if their weapons aren't magical or silvered, they're just wasting time against the Emerald Wanderer.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Ruling check: Encumbrance and Gear Slots.

GMs: Enforce the Strength-based gear slot limit; exceeding it means disadvantage on all physical checks.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Ring of Spell Turning requires attunement - without it, the ring's benefits are unavailable.

DMs: Make sure the Ring of Spell Turning is attuned, or your players will be sitting ducks for spells.

Judges: remind players that matched castings in Spell Duels can trigger phlogiston disturbances and corruption, often reducing the loser to ash.

Acolyte's Healing Touch often frustrates players - it heals 1d4 HP within close range.

GMs: Force the Acolyte to waste its Healing Touch by separating it from allies with terrain, then focus-fire to eliminate it quickly.

Melee Attacks require a target within reach - not just line of sight.

DMs: Enforce that melee attacks require targets to be within reach, not just visible, to avoid endless debates.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Thieves regain burned Luck in a way no other class can - by performing improbable feats.

Judges: Have your thief roll a d20 for backstab every encounter to exploit that +4 bonus and recover Luck.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70
